verdict.rationale: The privacy policy documents linking Google Workspace, which grants access to Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive/Docs, and says data from these external sources is indexed. Hands-on reviewers confirm the Google Workspace permission step during onboarding and that the agent then acted with context. They also report it indexing and searching their emails to produce summaries. missing for 10: connectors beyond Google Workspace (e.g., Outlook, Dropbox, OneDrive), and hands-on corroboration of Drive and Calendar content being searched and used in answers (independent reports center on email).
